subtitle: Six months of art direction across a full album cycle.
projectDetailsHtml:
Six months on the road with 2.0. Merch, flyers, album and press assets, and every frame of video. One person handling the whole visual output of an album cycle.

Merch

Apparel graphics drawn by hand and built for the merch table.

Flyers

Every show got its own flyer. Animated where it earned it.

Film

Live set, filmed and edited. Short form cut from the same footage.

Ads

The same visuals ran as paid creative to grow the audience.

Photography by Cole Crusciel, Joe Buscarello, Luke Ivanovich.

name: Hug a Mug Coffeehouse & Ceramics Studio
headline: How a Coffee Shop Rebrand Increased Revenue by 22%
subtitle: Woman-owned, handmade syrups and beverages.
oneLineSummary: Logo/Brand Overhaul, telling the story of the Wednesday Addams of Coffee Shops
summary: Comprehensive Branding for the woman-owned dark academia coffee shop of North Jersey. We worked extensively in visuals, branching our logo philosophy out to a merch line and videography focus for social media and menu design.
principalType: DJR Roslindale, Coco Gothic, Contralto Big
projectDetailsHtml:
The premiere woman-owned, dark academia coffee shop of North Jersey.

Hug a Mug went from Overlooked Local Spot to a Must-Visit Coffeehouse.

One of few woman-owned coffee shops in Northern New Jersey, Hug a Mug Coffeehouse graced its town through lockdown, but lacked clear identity, strong customer recognition, and a cohesive visual system.

The original Canva-made logo wasn't rememberable, and didn't attract foot traffic.

Any photo/video evidence online wasn't as engaging as the actual shop itself.

Specialty Coffee and Homemade Syrups without a cohesive visual identity. Until now.

The Everyday Reminder of Homemade

In the Late Internet Era, strong brands have strong social media presence. We showcased weekly specials and fan favorites as cinematic sighs of relief, stopping the algorithm scroll to remind customers that if they ever need a space to relax, we're there.

Monthly scripting, shooting, and scheduling of "stop the scroll"-technique video production.

Custom menu screens, cup stamps, and signage to enhance the customer experience.

A lot of brands rely on scarcity-based messaging. You're missing out! You need this in your life! Hug a Mug is designed to chill out the racing thoughts, not exacerbating them. We're regularly collaborating with local talent that shows up, for free, as part of our content scheduling.

One of the best hugs I've received was in Hug a Mug.

The owner gave it to me on a Friday. It wasn't for any reason. She could just tell I needed it. "That's the kind of hug I give to my daughters," she said. If my 3 years of continued partnering with Hug a Mug can convey the right hug at the right time, then we've done the job well.

🏆 2023 NJ.com's "Top 43 Coffee Shops in New Jersey"

🏆 2024 NJ.com's "Top 51 Coffee Shops in New Jersey"

Within a year, DumpStat rocketed to the top of Spotify Podcast's "Dungeons and Dragons" section, comfortably sitting in the top five of all time. DumpStat grew to over 15,000 downloads per week within 2 years of production. We have partnered with successful Kickstarters, charities, and creators to give back to the community that has let us onto the airwaves and in their ears.
